# Decisions

## 2026-04-21

- Use local route mapping instead of linking users back to `ema.ai` or `ema.co`.
- Prefer placeholder routes over dead links for pages that have not yet been replicated.
- Keep the four implemented pages as real replicas and treat the rest of the Ema-owned route surface as a documented local backlog.
- Add a top-level `README.md` so a new teammate can understand scope, setup, current status, and known limitations without reading chat history.
